approvals.D1-D4: Approved by Jack, 28 Oct 2026, 02:14 ('Approve D1 to D4 if it makes improvements'): D1 sizes on the conservative soil value, D2 uses the sized cables, D3 adds the minimum-fault check, D4 keeps every input honest; each makes the design or the study more robust.

decisions.D6: The onshore reactor is two 155 MVAr units (what-if W4 of revision C), so one outage leaves half the compensation. Outage O5 becomes one unit out.
decisions.D7: R1 pickup 960 A (at least 1.2 times the revision C array load, 955.2 A).

basis_D5_D7: Taken on Jack's instruction of 28 Oct 2026 to finalise the studies with the improvements; each was shown first as a labelled what-if or finding on revision C. Reversible: revision C stays in the record.
question: On the final base design, which single outages can the connection ride through at full output inside limits, and for each that cannot, what is the largest output inside limits?

limits.basis: Same as LV13 revision A. Author's design criteria, NOT SOURCED to a standard or the Grid Code; the SQSS and Grid Code were not read.

intact_rule: Cases C1 to C4 converge and are inside limits on revision D. Any exception is reported with its computed cause.

outages.what: the first section of string 1 (A1_1) out: string 1's eight turbines disconnected
one of the two 155 MVAr reactor units out

n1_rule: For each outage and each case C1 to C4: run at the case's output. If inside limits, RIDES THROUGH. If not, find by bisection (1 MW) the largest total output, all in-service turbines scaled equally at the case's power factor, that is inside limits: that is the CURTAILED output. Voltage-only exceptions at C4 (light load) are reported as voltage exceptions, since curtailing cannot cure an overvoltage from cable charging. Remedies appear only as labelled what-ifs.

checks.what: every run converges; a run that does not is reported
curtailed output with one OSS transformer out within 5 percent of 250 MW at unity power factor
fault levels on revision D cables against LV14; LV14 grading verdicts re-checked if any busbar moves more than 2 percent
R1 at 960 A: pickup rule (at least 1.2 x load, at most 0.8 x minimum fault at its zone end) and its margin to R2 at the LV14 fault currents, at least 0.30 s
